_doc: Shared fixture table for the run-liveness lockstep test (amicode#2055). Asserted against BOTH status implementations (extension service + engine overlay). Ages are seconds before 'now'; lock is the run.lock contract (scratchpad/run-lock-contract.md). finished is the raw FINISHED file body. log_age_s null = no run.log.

cases.name: no lock, warm log -> solving (legacy)
no lock, cold log -> stalled (legacy)
no lock, no log, fresh run.toml -> solving (legacy)
no lock, finished -> finished (legacy)
no lock, failed -> failed (legacy)
fresh heartbeat, warm log -> solving
fresh heartbeat, cold log -> stalled (live orchestrator, quiet solver)
heartbeat just inside threshold (89 s) -> not dead
heartbeat just past threshold (91 s), warm log -> dead
stale heartbeat, cold log -> dead (beats stalled)
stale heartbeat, no log -> dead
stale heartbeat + completed FINISHED -> finished (marker wins)
stale heartbeat + failed FINISHED -> failed (marker wins)
stale heartbeat + aborted FINISHED -> aborted (marker wins)
stale heartbeat + torn FINISHED -> still dead (torn is not terminal)
stale heartbeat but ended=true, no FINISHED -> not dead (legacy cold-log rule)
stale heartbeat but ended=true, warm log -> solving
ended=false explicit, stale -> dead
corrupt lock file -> legacy (warm log -> solving)
corrupt lock file -> legacy (cold log -> stalled)
lock without heartbeat_at -> legacy
lock with unparseable heartbeat_at -> legacy
lock with non-object JSON -> legacy
